statement: Release 11.7 is a Home/research-workflow UX release. It carries forward all mechanistic, multimodal, pest, validation, uncertainty, decision-intelligence and causal-audit methods from 11.6 unchanged.

new_research_workflow_logic.priority_actions: Transparent rule-based prompts from persisted operational/evidence state; not an agronomic model.
new_research_workflow_logic.next_measurement: Transparent evidence-gap heuristic; not formal information-gain optimization.
new_research_workflow_logic.freshness: Persistent metadata freshness with explicit historical-season handling.
